title: Silver Rewards Card: Getting Started and Eligibility Requirements
summary: This document outlines Silver Rewards Card eligibility and setup: minimum credit score $680, $0.00 annual fee, 0% introductory APR for the first year, and 18.99% standard APR after promotional periods. It lists foreign transaction fees (2.75% without premium, 0% with premium), typical initial credit limits ($10,000–$100,000), purchase protection (90 days, up to $3,000 per claim), and rewards (1.0% back on purchases outside top categories). It also states there is no virtual card management, and provides the online application steps and post-approval actions (activate physical card, add to digital wallets, set alerts/autopay).
